ja159:1.1: “One king” (_ekarāja_) is used of an actual king at [ja303]() and [ja542](). Indra is called the “one king” at Rig Veda 8.37.3.
ja159:1.2: _Harissa_ is Vedic _haryaśva_, “yellow horse” or more commonly “he of the yellow horses”, a name of Indra. He is named such in worship of the sun and dawn at Rig Veda 3.30.12–13 and Rig Veda 3.44.2.
ja159:1.3: Commentary glosses _taṁ taṁ_ with _tasmā taṁ_, “therefore (I worship) him”, but I take it as emphatic.
